description: A conditional experiment on the #974 observation interface: a stipulated surgical change of either public contributor (with the other true) changes an active AND target, while an idle lookup with identical natural observations ignores both overrides. A one-slot pair-valued hidden state and two independently stored Boolean root-state slots are interventionally equivalent for all public overrides; a one-bit state cannot cover all four pairs. The preexisting #974 graph source-count fork remains. These results do not certify actual surgical accessibility, productive causation, ontic simplicity or unique ultimate explanation.
